plan.title: bug(doctor,hooks): advisory #3242 completed-open-items hard-blocks Write/Task so official recovery is unreachable

narratives.Description: Map completed-open-items through cmdDoctor as a warning so historical completed/ open items do not fail gated ritual or deny Write/Task. Keep completed-lifecycle-consistency and new scope:complete fail-closed.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`completed-open-items` (#3242) is documented as **advisory** for historical `xbrief/completed/` corpora, but a dirty doctor still fails `session:ready` gated ritual and **fail-closes Write and Task implement**. The official fix is editing those completed JSON item statuses to terminal. Editing requires Write. Write is blocked until doctor is clean. There is no stamp/backfill CLI. Recovery is unreachable from the session that discovered the failure.

## Repro (consumer: deftai/agentsentri, 2026-08-14)

Content deposit **v0.103.0** after `deft update` (v0.99.0 → v0.103.0).

1. Historical completed xBRIEFs left `plan.items[].status` as `proposed` / `running` when scopes were completed pre-#2862 (datasets via PR #9, prompts via PR #13, A2A via PR #69; parity-research Story A shipped as a successor xBRIEF).
2. `deft doctor --full` → `completed-open-items: fail` with copy that the historical corpus is **advisory until backfill** and that `scope:complete` fails closed on this class.
3. Doctor records `lastErrorCount > 0` → `doctor.ok=false` in orientation / ritual state.
4. `deft session:ready` fails gated step `doctor`.
5. Cursor Write / StrReplace on `xbrief/completed/*.xbrief.json` denied: session ritual gated step `doctor` failed. Recovery text points back at `session:ready`.
6. Task `generalPurpose` (implement) denied for the same reason. Explore-only Task still works.
7. `commands.md` has no `scope:stamp-evidence` / bulk backfill command. `stampNamespacedEvidence` is library-only, invoked by `scope:complete` on **active** scopes — not historical `completed/` files.

Operator-authorized backfill therefore cannot be applied by the same agent session. Product work (review-cycle fix on [agentsentri#110](https://github.com/deftai/agentsentri/pull/110), already merged) left an active xBRIEF that also cannot `scope:complete` while Write is blocked.

## Locked decision (2026-08-14)

Valid bug. Close **option 1** on this issue: treat `completed-open-items` as advisory through `cmdDoctor` / gated ritual / PreToolUse, the same way other exit-exempt doctor checks become warnings.

Cause in current source (not consumer-only): `deriveExitCode` already exit-exempts `completed-open-items`. The check still returns `status: "fail"`. `packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts` maps unlisted fails to `severity: "error"`, so `lastErrorCount > 0` and doctor exit 1. Gated ritual runs `cmdDoctor`, not `deriveExitCode`. `session:ready` then fails step `doctor`. Write/Task deny and point back at `session:ready`.

Unit tests lock only the checks-layer exit 0. They do not lock the doctor findings mapper.

A no-Write stamp/backfill CLI is a **follow-up**, not this story.

Do not require a fake product `scope:activate` to edit bookkeeping JSON.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Historical `completed/` with non-terminal `plan.items` only: `deft doctor --full` exits 0, `lastErrorCount` is 0, and the finding is a **warning** that still names the artifact paths.
- [ ] `session:ready` / gated ritual `doctor` is ok for that corpus alone. PreToolUse does not deny Write/Task solely for this check.
- [ ] `completed-lifecycle-consistency` still hard-fails on `plan.status` drift or unreadable artifacts.
- [ ] `scope:complete` still fails closed on open items for **new** completes.
- [ ] A `cmdDoctor` / ritual test locks the three bullets above. Do not rely on `deriveExitCode` alone.

## Non-goals

- New `scope:stamp-evidence` / bulk backfill CLI (follow-up).
- Silent drop of the finding (warning must still name paths).
- Changing `#3240` / `#3305` acceptance-evidence on `scope:complete`.
- Repairing the agentsentri leftover active brief in this issue.

## Caveat

If any `completed/` file also has non-terminal `plan.status`, option 1 will not unblock Write. That is `completed-lifecycle-consistency`, a different hard check. Confirm the consumer corpus is open-items-only before claiming recovery.

After Write returns, the leftover active PR-110 brief can still fail `#3240` evidence on `scope:complete`. That is separate.

## Actual

Doctor is “advisory” in prose and hard-fail in the mutation hook. The recovery listed on the deny (`session:ready` / edit the files) is the blocked path.

## Related

- #3242 `completed-open-items` (closed framework-gap; this is the consumer hook wiring)
- #2862 `scope:complete` left own `plan.items[].status` pending (why the historical corpus is dirty)
- #3240 / #3305 `scope:complete` acceptance evidence (distinct gate; also blocked here)
- #3259 Cursor Multitask residual (context: implement Task already needs an active xBRIEF)

## Consumer leftovers (not the bug, just the stuck state)

- https://github.com/deftai/agentsentri
- Active: `xbrief/active/2026-08-14-pr-110-bound-dependency-overrides.xbrief.json` (PR 110 merged; needs evidence + `scope:complete` after Write unblocks)

narratives.UserStory: As a consumer agent, I want completed-open-items to warn without failing doctor, so that Write and Task stay available for official recovery.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Edit source file packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts: map completed-open-items fail to severity warning in the cmdDoctor findings mapper (same allowlist pattern as other exit-exempt checks) so lastErrorCount is 0 and doctor exit is 0 while the finding still names artifact paths. Keep completed-lifecycle-consistency as error. Do not change scope:complete fail-closed on new completes. Add a cmdDoctor / ritual test in packages/core/src/doctor/ that verifies a historical completed/ corpus with only open plan.items exits 0 with warning severity and lastErrorCount 0. Evidence: cmdDoctor --full --json plus the new test.

narrative.Acceptance: Given historical completed/ with non-terminal plan.items only, when deft doctor --full runs, it exits 0, lastErrorCount is 0, and the completed-open-items finding is a warning that still names the artifact paths.
Given that corpus alone, when session:ready / gated ritual doctor runs, doctor is ok and PreToolUse does not deny Write/Task solely for completed-open-items.
Given completed-lifecycle-consistency drift or unreadable artifacts, when doctor runs, that check still hard-fails. scope:complete still fails closed on open items for new completes.
Given the mapper change, when the cmdDoctor / ritual test runs, it locks warning mapping, lastErrorCount 0, and lifecycle-consistency still error. It does not rely on deriveExitCode alone.
